index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..97fefc7ccbac18069933c3fa8ebb3c738205ccae
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/test_data_freshness.py
@@ -0,0 +1,148 @@
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+from mike_trade.market_data.quality import FeedQualityTracker, HealthState
+
+
+class Clock:
+    def __init__(self, value):
+        self.value = value
+
+    def now(self):
+        return self.value
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Event:
+    symbol: str
+    provider_source_ts: datetime
+    receive_ts: datetime
+    feed_id: str = "sip"
+    price: Decimal = Decimal("10")
+    size: Decimal = Decimal("2")
+    sequence_id: int | None = None
+    kind: str = "trade"
+
+
+def tracker(clock, **kwargs):
+    configured_feed_id = kwargs.pop("configured_feed_id", "sip")
+    return FeedQualityTracker(
+        clock=clock,
+        staleness_seconds={"trades": 5, "bars": 90},
+        session_calendar=lambda _now: True,
+        configured_feed_id=configured_feed_id,
+        **kwargs,
+    )
+
+
+def test_age_and_transport_latency_use_distinct_timestamps():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, 0, 10, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now))
+    assert t.ingest(Event("AAPL", now - timedelta(seconds=8), now - timedelta(seconds=3)))
+    fresh = t.symbol_health("AAPL").channels["trades"]
+    assert fresh.age_seconds == 8
+    assert fresh.transport_latency_seconds == 5
+
+
+def test_regular_session_staleness_degrades_and_blocks_entry():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now), stream_activity_gap_seconds=120)
+    t.ingest(Event("AAPL", now - timedelta(seconds=6), now - timedelta(seconds=5)))
+    assert t.symbol_health("AAPL").state is HealthState.DEGRADED
+    decision = t.entries_allowed("AAPL")
+    assert not decision.allowed
+    assert decision.reason_code == "STALE_DATA"
+
+
+def test_unknown_freshness_fails_closed():
+    decision = tracker(Clock(datetime(2026, 1, 5, tzinfo=timezone.utc))).entries_allowed("MSFT")
+    assert not decision.allowed
+    assert decision.reason_code == "UNKNOWN_FRESHNESS"
+
+
+def test_duplicates_by_sequence_and_fallback_are_counted_without_refresh():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now))
+    event = Event("AAPL", now - timedelta(seconds=1), now - timedelta(seconds=1), sequence_id=77)
+    assert t.ingest(event)
+    assert not t.ingest(event)
+    # A later receive time for the same provider sequence remains a duplicate.
+    duplicate = Event("AAPL", event.provider_source_ts, now, sequence_id=77)
+    assert not t.ingest(duplicate)
+    key_event = Event("MSFT", event.provider_source_ts, event.receive_ts, sequence_id=None)
+    assert t.ingest(key_event)
+    assert not t.ingest(key_event)
+    assert t.symbol_health("AAPL").channels["trades"].receive_ts == event.receive_ts
+    assert t.symbol_health("AAPL").channels["trades"].duplicate_count == 2
+    assert t.symbol_health("MSFT").channels["trades"].duplicate_count == 1
+
+
+def test_out_of_order_event_is_counted_without_replacing_latest_source_time():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now), stream_activity_gap_seconds=120)
+    latest = Event("AAPL", now - timedelta(seconds=1), now, sequence_id=2)
+    older = Event("AAPL", now - timedelta(seconds=3), now, sequence_id=1)
+    t.ingest(latest)
+    t.ingest(older)
+    fresh = t.symbol_health("AAPL").channels["trades"]
+    assert fresh.provider_source_ts == latest.provider_source_ts
+    assert fresh.out_of_order_count == 1
+
+
+def test_fresh_polling_fallback_allows_entries_when_stream_disconnects():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now))
+    t.set_stream_connected(False)
+    t.ingest(Event("AAPL", now, now), source="poll")
+    assert t.symbol_health("AAPL").state is HealthState.HEALTHY
+    assert t.entries_allowed("AAPL").allowed
+
+
+def test_missing_completed_minute_bar_blocks_until_recovered():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, 5, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now), stream_activity_gap_seconds=300)
+    first = now - timedelta(minutes=3)
+    t.ingest(Event("AAPL", first, first + timedelta(seconds=1), kind="bar"))
+    t.ingest(Event("AAPL", first + timedelta(minutes=2), first + timedelta(minutes=2, seconds=1), kind="bar"))
+    assert t.symbol_health("AAPL").unresolved_gaps == (first + timedelta(minutes=1),)
+    assert t.entries_allowed("AAPL").reason_code == "UNRESOLVED_GAP"
+    t.mark_gap_recovered("AAPL", first + timedelta(minutes=1))
+    assert t.entries_allowed("AAPL").allowed
+
+
+def test_feed_provenance_mismatch_and_iex_consolidation():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now), configured_feed_id="sip")
+    t.ingest(Event("AAPL", now, now, feed_id="iex"))
+    health = t.symbol_health("AAPL")
+    assert health.feed.feed_id == "iex"
+    assert health.feed.consolidated is False
+    assert health.feed.entitlement_mismatch
+    assert t.entries_allowed("AAPL").reason_code == "ENTITLEMENT_MISMATCH"
+
+
+def test_unrecognized_feed_id_fails_closed():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now))
+    t.ingest(Event("AAPL", now, now, feed_id="mystery"))
+    assert t.entries_allowed("AAPL").reason_code == "UNKNOWN_FEED_ID"
+
+
+def test_rate_limit_counters_and_backoff_are_projected():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now))
+    t.record_request(status_code=200)
+    t.record_request(status_code=429, backoff_seconds=12)
+    snapshot = t.service_health()
+    assert snapshot.rate_limit.requests_used == 2
+    assert snapshot.rate_limit.responses_429 == 1
+    assert snapshot.rate_limit.backoff_seconds == 12
+    assert snapshot.state is HealthState.DEGRADED
+
+
+def test_health_controls_entries_only():
+    assert "fills" in FeedQualityTracker.__doc__
+    assert not any(name in FeedQualityTracker.__dict__ for name in (
+        "block_fill", "block_order_update", "block_stop", "block_reconciliation", "block_manual_close"
+    ))

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..985b3d7b969d7fcd2306396b1c7d094e55f725f2

+++ b/mike_trade/market_data/quality.py
@@ -0,0 +1,331 @@
+"""Market-data freshness and provenance health for new-entry decisions only.
+
+This module exposes no controls over broker fills, order updates, stops,
+reconciliation, or manual closes. Its health assessment can only be queried
+through :meth:`FeedQualityTracker.entries_allowed` for prospective entries.
+Snapshots are immutable values suitable for status projections and dashboards.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections import deque
+from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import StrEnum
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import Any
+
+__all__ = [
+    "HealthState", "ChannelFreshness", "FeedProvenanceSnapshot", "RateLimitSnapshot",
+    "SymbolHealthSnapshot", "ServiceHealthSnapshot", "EntryDecision", "FeedQualityTracker",
+]
+
+
+class HealthState(StrEnum):
+    HEALTHY = "HEALTHY"
+    DEGRADED = "DEGRADED"
+    OFFLINE = "OFFLINE"
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(timezone.utc)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ChannelFreshness:
+    symbol: str
+    channel: str
+    provider_source_ts: datetime
+    receive_ts: datetime
+    age_seconds: float
+    transport_latency_seconds: float
+    source: str
+    stale: bool
+    out_of_order_count: int
+    duplicate_count: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class FeedProvenanceSnapshot:
+    feed_id: str | None
+    consolidated: bool | None
+    configured_feed_id: str | None
+    entitlement_mismatch: bool
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class RateLimitSnapshot:
+    requests_used: int
+    responses_429: int
+    backoff_until: datetime | None
+    backoff_seconds: float
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SymbolHealthSnapshot:
+    symbol: str
+    state: HealthState
+    channels: Mapping[str, ChannelFreshness]
+    feed: FeedProvenanceSnapshot
+    unresolved_gaps: tuple[datetime, ...]
+    stream_connected: bool
+    stream_gap: bool
+    reasons: tuple[str, ...]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ServiceHealthSnapshot:
+    state: HealthState
+    stream_connected: bool
+    rate_limit: RateLimitSnapshot
+    reasons: tuple[str, ...]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class EntryDecision:
+    allowed: bool
+    reason_code: str | None
+
+
+class FeedQualityTracker:
+    """Track data health; only ``entries_allowed`` expresses entry eligibility.
+
+    The tracker cannot block broker fills, order updates, stops, reconciliation,
+    or manual closes.
+
+    ``session_calendar`` returns whether regular-session freshness rules apply
+    at the supplied UTC time. Staleness thresholds are seconds by channel.
+    Events may be normalized stream records, poll snapshots, or MarketEvent-like
+    values carrying equivalent timestamp/provenance fields.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        clock: Any,
+        staleness_seconds: Mapping[str, float],
+        session_calendar: Callable[[datetime], bool],
+        configured_feed_id: str | None = None,
+        seen_window: int = 4096,
+        stream_activity_gap_seconds: float = 30.0,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not callable(getattr(clock, "now", None)):
+            raise TypeError("clock must expose now()")
+        if not callable(session_calendar):
+            raise TypeError("session_calendar must be callable")
+        if seen_window < 1 or stream_activity_gap_seconds < 0:
+            raise ValueError("seen_window must be positive and stream gap non-negative")
+        if any(float(v) < 0 for v in staleness_seconds.values()):
+            raise ValueError("staleness thresholds must be non-negative")
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._thresholds = {str(k).lower(): float(v) for k, v in staleness_seconds.items()}
+        self._session = session_calendar
+        self._configured_feed = configured_feed_id.lower() if configured_feed_id else None
+        self._seen_window = seen_window
+        self._stream_gap_seconds = float(stream_activity_gap_seconds)
+        self._freshness: dict[tuple[str, str], ChannelFreshness] = {}
+        self._latest_source_ts: dict[tuple[str, str], datetime] = {}
+        self._seen: set[tuple[Any, ...]] = set()
+        self._seen_order: deque[tuple[Any, ...]] = deque()
+        self._feed_id: str | None = None
+        self._stream_connected = True
+        self._last_stream_activity: datetime | None = None
+        self._gaps: dict[str, set[datetime]] = {}
+        self._last_bar: dict[str, datetime] = {}
+        self._requests_used = 0
+        self._responses_429 = 0
+        self._backoff_until: datetime | None = None
+
+    def ingest(self, event: Any, *, channel: str | None = None, source: str = "stream") -> bool:
+        """Record an event; returns False for a duplicate (not fresh activity)."""
+        symbol = str(getattr(event, "symbol", "")).strip().upper()
+        if not symbol:
+            raise ValueError("event must have a symbol")
+        ts = getattr(event, "provider_source_ts", None)
+        if ts is None:
+            ts = getattr(event, "event_time", None)
+        receive = getattr(event, "receive_ts", None)
+        if receive is None:
+            receive = getattr(event, "received_at", None)
+        if ts is None or receive is None:
+            raise ValueError("event must have provider source and receive timestamps")
+        ts, receive = _utc(ts, "provider_source_ts"), _utc(receive, "receive_ts")
+        kind = channel or getattr(event, "kind", "unknown")
+        kind = getattr(kind, "value", kind)
+        kind = str(kind).lower()
+        kind = {"trade": "trades", "quote": "quotes", "bar": "bars"}.get(kind, kind)
+        feed_id = getattr(event, "feed_id", None)
+        provenance = getattr(event, "provenance", None)
+        if feed_id is None and provenance is not None:
+            feed_id = getattr(provenance, "feed", None)
+        if feed_id:
+            self._feed_id = str(feed_id).strip().lower()
+
+        sequence = getattr(event, "sequence_id", None)
+        trade_id = getattr(event, "trade_id", None)
+        price = getattr(event, "price", getattr(event, "close", None))
+        size = getattr(event, "size", getattr(event, "volume", None))
+        if price is None and hasattr(event, "close"):
+            price = event.close
+        if sequence is not None or trade_id is not None:
+            identity = ("id", symbol, kind, sequence if sequence is not None else trade_id)
+        else:
+            identity = ("fallback", symbol, ts, str(price), str(size))
+        if identity in self._seen:
+            key = (symbol, kind)
+            previous = self._freshness.get(key)
+            if previous:
+                self._freshness[key] = ChannelFreshness(
+                    previous.symbol, previous.channel, previous.provider_source_ts,
+                    previous.receive_ts, previous.age_seconds, previous.transport_latency_seconds,
+                    previous.source, previous.stale, previous.out_of_order_count,
+                    previous.duplicate_count + 1,
+                )
+            return False
+        self._seen.add(identity)
+        self._seen_order.append(identity)
+        if len(self._seen_order) > self._seen_window:
+            self._seen.discard(self._seen_order.popleft())
+
+        now = _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")
+        key = (symbol, kind)
+        prior_ts = self._latest_source_ts.get(key)
+        out_of_order = prior_ts is not None and ts < prior_ts
+        if out_of_order:
+            old = self._freshness.get(key)
+            if old:
+                self._freshness[key] = ChannelFreshness(
+                    old.symbol, old.channel, old.provider_source_ts, old.receive_ts,
+                    old.age_seconds, old.transport_latency_seconds, old.source, old.stale,
+                    old.out_of_order_count + 1, old.duplicate_count,
+                )
+            if source == "stream":
+                self._last_stream_activity = receive
+            return True
+        if not out_of_order:
+            self._latest_source_ts[key] = ts
+        old = self._freshness.get(key)
+        threshold = self._thresholds.get(kind)
+        stale = bool(threshold is not None and self._session(now) and (now - ts).total_seconds() > threshold)
+        self._freshness[key] = ChannelFreshness(
+            symbol, kind, ts, receive, (now - ts).total_seconds(),
+            (receive - ts).total_seconds(), source, stale,
+            (old.out_of_order_count if old else 0) + int(out_of_order),
+            old.duplicate_count if old else 0,
+        )
+        if source == "stream":
+            self._last_stream_activity = receive
+        if kind == "bars":
+            self._record_bar(symbol, ts, now)
+        return True
+
+    def _record_bar(self, symbol: str, ts: datetime, now: datetime) -> None:
+        previous = self._last_bar.get(symbol)
+        if previous is not None and ts > previous:
+            cursor = previous + timedelta(minutes=1)
+            while cursor < ts:
+                if cursor + timedelta(minutes=1) <= now:
+                    self._gaps.setdefault(symbol, set()).add(cursor)
+                cursor += timedelta(minutes=1)
+        if previous is None or ts > previous:
+            self._last_bar[symbol] = ts
+
+    def mark_gap_recovered(self, symbol: str, bar_start: datetime) -> None:
+        self._gaps.get(symbol.strip().upper(), set()).discard(_utc(bar_start, "bar_start"))
+
+    def set_stream_connected(self, connected: bool) -> None:
+        self._stream_connected = bool(connected)
+
+    def record_request(self, *, status_code: int | None = None, backoff_seconds: float = 0) -> None:
+        self._requests_used += 1
+        now = _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")
+        if status_code == 429:
+            self._responses_429 += 1
+            if backoff_seconds > 0:
+                until = now + timedelta(seconds=float(backoff_seconds))
+                self._backoff_until = max(self._backoff_until or until, until)
+
+    def rate_limit_snapshot(self) -> RateLimitSnapshot:
+        now = _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")
+        until = self._backoff_until if self._backoff_until and self._backoff_until > now else None
+        return RateLimitSnapshot(
+            self._requests_used, self._responses_429, until,
+            max(0.0, (until - now).total_seconds()) if until else 0.0,
+        )
+
+    def _stream_gap(self, now: datetime) -> bool:
+        return bool(self._last_stream_activity and self._session(now) and
+                    (now - self._last_stream_activity).total_seconds() > self._stream_gap_seconds)
+
+    def symbol_health(self, symbol: str) -> SymbolHealthSnapshot:
+        symbol, now = symbol.strip().upper(), _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")
+        channels: dict[str, ChannelFreshness] = {}
+        reasons: list[str] = []
+        for (sym, channel), item in self._freshness.items():
+            if sym != symbol:
+                continue
+            threshold = self._thresholds.get(channel)
+            stale = bool(threshold is not None and self._session(now) and
+                         (now - item.provider_source_ts).total_seconds() > threshold)
+            channels[channel] = ChannelFreshness(
+                item.symbol, item.channel, item.provider_source_ts, item.receive_ts,
+                (now - item.provider_source_ts).total_seconds(),
+                (item.receive_ts - item.provider_source_ts).total_seconds(), item.source,
+                stale, item.out_of_order_count, item.duplicate_count,
+            )
+            if stale:
+                reasons.append("STALE_DATA")
+        feed_id = self._feed_id
+        mismatch = bool(feed_id and self._configured_feed and feed_id != self._configured_feed)
+        provenance = FeedProvenanceSnapshot(
+            feed_id, False if feed_id == "iex" else (True if feed_id == "sip" else None),
+            self._configured_feed, mismatch,
+        )
+        gaps = tuple(sorted(self._gaps.get(symbol, ())))
+        if gaps:
+            reasons.append("UNRESOLVED_GAP")
+        if mismatch:
+            reasons.append("ENTITLEMENT_MISMATCH")
+        if feed_id not in {"iex", "sip"}:
+            reasons.append("UNKNOWN_FEED_ID")
+        fresh_fallback = any(c.source != "stream" and not c.stale for c in channels.values())
+        gap = self._stream_gap(now) and not (not self._stream_connected and fresh_fallback)
+        if gap:
+            reasons.append("STREAM_ACTIVITY_GAP")
+        if not self._stream_connected and not any(c.source != "stream" and not c.stale for c in channels.values()):
+            reasons.append("STREAM_DISCONNECTED")
+        if not channels:
+            reasons.append("UNKNOWN_FRESHNESS")
+        state = HealthState.OFFLINE if not channels or (not self._stream_connected and "STREAM_DISCONNECTED" in reasons) else (
+            HealthState.DEGRADED if reasons else HealthState.HEALTHY
+        )
+        return SymbolHealthSnapshot(symbol, state, MappingProxyType(channels), provenance,
+                                    gaps, self._stream_connected, gap, tuple(dict.fromkeys(reasons)))
+
+    def service_health(self) -> ServiceHealthSnapshot:
+        now = _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")
+        reasons = []
+        if not self._stream_connected:
+            reasons.append("STREAM_DISCONNECTED")
+        if self.rate_limit_snapshot().backoff_until:
+            reasons.append("RATE_LIMIT_BACKOFF")
+        state = HealthState.OFFLINE if not self._stream_connected else HealthState.DEGRADED if reasons else HealthState.HEALTHY
+        return ServiceHealthSnapshot(state, self._stream_connected, self.rate_limit_snapshot(), tuple(reasons))
+
+    def entries_allowed(self, symbol: str) -> EntryDecision:
+        health = self.symbol_health(symbol)
+        priority = ("UNKNOWN_FRESHNESS", "STALE_DATA", "UNRESOLVED_GAP", "STREAM_DISCONNECTED",
+                    "UNKNOWN_FEED_ID", "ENTITLEMENT_MISMATCH", "STREAM_ACTIVITY_GAP")
+        for code in priority:
+            if code in health.reasons:
+                # A disconnected stream with fresh polling data is permitted.
+                if code == "STREAM_DISCONNECTED" and any(
+                    c.source != "stream" and not c.stale for c in health.channels.values()
+                ):
+                    continue
+                return EntryDecision(False, code)
+        return EntryDecision(True, None)

+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+from mike_trade.market_data.quality import FeedQualityTracker, HealthState
+
+
+class Clock:
+    def __init__(self, value):
+        self.value = value
+
+    def now(self):
+        return self.value
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Event:
+    symbol: str
+    provider_source_ts: datetime
+    receive_ts: datetime
+    feed_id: str = "sip"
+    price: Decimal = Decimal("10")
+    size: Decimal = Decimal("2")
+    sequence_id: int | None = None
+    kind: str = "trade"
+
+
+def tracker(clock, **kwargs):
+    configured_feed_id = kwargs.pop("configured_feed_id", "sip")
+    return FeedQualityTracker(
+        clock=clock,
+        staleness_seconds={"trades": 5, "bars": 90},
+        session_calendar=lambda _now: True,
+        configured_feed_id=configured_feed_id,
+        **kwargs,
+    )
+
+
+def test_age_and_transport_latency_use_distinct_timestamps():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, 0, 10, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now))
+    assert t.ingest(Event("AAPL", now - timedelta(seconds=8), now - timedelta(seconds=3)))
+    fresh = t.symbol_health("AAPL").channels["trades"]
+    assert fresh.age_seconds == 8
+    assert fresh.transport_latency_seconds == 5
+
+
+def test_regular_session_staleness_degrades_and_blocks_entry():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now), stream_activity_gap_seconds=120)
+    t.ingest(Event("AAPL", now - timedelta(seconds=6), now - timedelta(seconds=5)))
+    assert t.symbol_health("AAPL").state is HealthState.DEGRADED
+    decision = t.entries_allowed("AAPL")
+    assert not decision.allowed
+    assert decision.reason_code == "STALE_DATA"
+
+
+def test_unknown_freshness_fails_closed():
+    decision = tracker(Clock(datetime(2026, 1, 5, tzinfo=timezone.utc))).entries_allowed("MSFT")
+    assert not decision.allowed
+    assert decision.reason_code == "UNKNOWN_FRESHNESS"
+
+
+def test_duplicates_by_sequence_and_fallback_are_counted_without_refresh():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now))
+    event = Event("AAPL", now - timedelta(seconds=1), now - timedelta(seconds=1), sequence_id=77)
+    assert t.ingest(event)
+    assert not t.ingest(event)
+    # A later receive time for the same provider sequence remains a duplicate.
+    duplicate = Event("AAPL", event.provider_source_ts, now, sequence_id=77)
+    assert not t.ingest(duplicate)
+    key_event = Event("MSFT", event.provider_source_ts, event.receive_ts, sequence_id=None)
+    assert t.ingest(key_event)
+    assert not t.ingest(key_event)
+    assert t.symbol_health("AAPL").channels["trades"].receive_ts == event.receive_ts
+    assert t.symbol_health("AAPL").channels["trades"].duplicate_count == 2
+    assert t.symbol_health("MSFT").channels["trades"].duplicate_count == 1
+
+
+def test_out_of_order_event_is_counted_without_replacing_latest_source_time():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now), stream_activity_gap_seconds=120)
+    latest = Event("AAPL", now - timedelta(seconds=1), now, sequence_id=2)
+    older = Event("AAPL", now - timedelta(seconds=3), now, sequence_id=1)
+    t.ingest(latest)
+    t.ingest(older)
+    fresh = t.symbol_health("AAPL").channels["trades"]
+    assert fresh.provider_source_ts == latest.provider_source_ts
+    assert fresh.out_of_order_count == 1
+
+
+def test_fresh_polling_fallback_allows_entries_when_stream_disconnects():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now))
+    t.set_stream_connected(False)
+    t.ingest(Event("AAPL", now, now), source="poll")
+    assert t.symbol_health("AAPL").state is HealthState.HEALTHY
+    assert t.entries_allowed("AAPL").allowed
+
+
+def test_missing_completed_minute_bar_blocks_until_recovered():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, 5, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now), stream_activity_gap_seconds=300)
+    first = now - timedelta(minutes=3)
+    t.ingest(Event("AAPL", first, first + timedelta(seconds=1), kind="bar"))
+    t.ingest(Event("AAPL", first + timedelta(minutes=2), first + timedelta(minutes=2, seconds=1), kind="bar"))
+    assert t.symbol_health("AAPL").unresolved_gaps == (first + timedelta(minutes=1),)
+    assert t.entries_allowed("AAPL").reason_code == "UNRESOLVED_GAP"
+    t.mark_gap_recovered("AAPL", first + timedelta(minutes=1))
+    assert t.entries_allowed("AAPL").allowed
+
+
+def test_feed_provenance_mismatch_and_iex_consolidation():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now), configured_feed_id="sip")
+    t.ingest(Event("AAPL", now, now, feed_id="iex"))
+    health = t.symbol_health("AAPL")
+    assert health.feed.feed_id == "iex"
+    assert health.feed.consolidated is False
+    assert health.feed.entitlement_mismatch
+    assert t.entries_allowed("AAPL").reason_code == "ENTITLEMENT_MISMATCH"
+
+
+def test_unrecognized_feed_id_fails_closed():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now))
+    t.ingest(Event("AAPL", now, now, feed_id="mystery"))
+    assert t.entries_allowed("AAPL").reason_code == "UNKNOWN_FEED_ID"
+
+
+def test_rate_limit_counters_and_backoff_are_projected():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now))
+    t.record_request(status_code=200)
+    t.record_request(status_code=429, backoff_seconds=12)
+    snapshot = t.service_health()
+    assert snapshot.rate_limit.requests_used == 2
+    assert snapshot.rate_limit.responses_429 == 1
+    assert snapshot.rate_limit.backoff_seconds == 12
+    assert snapshot.state is HealthState.DEGRADED
+
+
+def test_health_controls_entries_only():
+    assert "fills" in FeedQualityTracker.__doc__
+    assert not any(name in FeedQualityTracker.__dict__ for name in (
+        "block_fill", "block_order_update", "block_stop", "block_reconciliation", "block_manual_close"
+    ))

+"""Market-data freshness and provenance health for new-entry decisions only.
+
+This module exposes no controls over broker fills, order updates, stops,
+reconciliation, or manual closes. Its health assessment can only be queried
+through :meth:`FeedQualityTracker.entries_allowed` for prospective entries.
+Snapshots are immutable values suitable for status projections and dashboards.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections import deque
+from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import StrEnum
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import Any
+
+__all__ = [
+    "HealthState", "ChannelFreshness", "FeedProvenanceSnapshot", "RateLimitSnapshot",
+    "SymbolHealthSnapshot", "ServiceHealthSnapshot", "EntryDecision", "FeedQualityTracker",
+]
+
+
+class HealthState(StrEnum):
+    HEALTHY = "HEALTHY"
+    DEGRADED = "DEGRADED"
+    OFFLINE = "OFFLINE"
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(timezone.utc)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ChannelFreshness:
+    symbol: str
+    channel: str
+    provider_source_ts: datetime
+    receive_ts: datetime
+    age_seconds: float
+    transport_latency_seconds: float
+    source: str
+    stale: bool
+    out_of_order_count: int
+    duplicate_count: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class FeedProvenanceSnapshot:
+    feed_id: str | None
+    consolidated: bool | None
+    configured_feed_id: str | None
+    entitlement_mismatch: bool
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class RateLimitSnapshot:
+    requests_used: int
+    responses_429: int
+    backoff_until: datetime | None
+    backoff_seconds: float
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SymbolHealthSnapshot:
+    symbol: str
+    state: HealthState
+    channels: Mapping[str, ChannelFreshness]
+    feed: FeedProvenanceSnapshot
+    unresolved_gaps: tuple[datetime, ...]
+    stream_connected: bool
+    stream_gap: bool
+    reasons: tuple[str, ...]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ServiceHealthSnapshot:
+    state: HealthState
+    stream_connected: bool
+    rate_limit: RateLimitSnapshot
+    reasons: tuple[str, ...]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class EntryDecision:
+    allowed: bool
+    reason_code: str | None
+
+
+class FeedQualityTracker:
+    """Track data health; only ``entries_allowed`` expresses entry eligibility.
+
+    The tracker cannot block broker fills, order updates, stops, reconciliation,
+    or manual closes.
+
+    ``session_calendar`` returns whether regular-session freshness rules apply
+    at the supplied UTC time. Staleness thresholds are seconds by channel.
+    Events may be normalized stream records, poll snapshots, or MarketEvent-like
+    values carrying equivalent timestamp/provenance fields.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        clock: Any,
+        staleness_seconds: Mapping[str, float],
+        session_calendar: Callable[[datetime], bool],
+        configured_feed_id: str | None = None,
+        seen_window: int = 4096,
+        stream_activity_gap_seconds: float = 30.0,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not callable(getattr(clock, "now", None)):
+            raise TypeError("clock must expose now()")
+        if not callable(session_calendar):
+            raise TypeError("session_calendar must be callable")
+        if seen_window < 1 or stream_activity_gap_seconds < 0:
+            raise ValueError("seen_window must be positive and stream gap non-negative")
+        if any(float(v) < 0 for v in staleness_seconds.values()):
+            raise ValueError("staleness thresholds must be non-negative")
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._thresholds = {str(k).lower(): float(v) for k, v in staleness_seconds.items()}
+        self._session = session_calendar
+        self._configured_feed = configured_feed_id.lower() if configured_feed_id else None
+        self._seen_window = seen_window
+        self._stream_gap_seconds = float(stream_activity_gap_seconds)
+        self._freshness: dict[tuple[str, str], ChannelFreshness] = {}
+        self._latest_source_ts: dict[tuple[str, str], datetime] = {}
+        self._seen: set[tuple[Any, ...]] = set()
+        self._seen_order: deque[tuple[Any, ...]] = deque()
+        self._feed_id: str | None = None
+        self._stream_connected = True
+        self._last_stream_activity: datetime | None = None
+        self._gaps: dict[str, set[datetime]] = {}
+        self._last_bar: dict[str, datetime] = {}
+        self._requests_used = 0
+        self._responses_429 = 0
+        self._backoff_until: datetime | None = None
+
+    def ingest(self, event: Any, *, channel: str | None = None, source: str = "stream") -> bool:
+        """Record an event; returns False for a duplicate (not fresh activity)."""
+        symbol = str(getattr(event, "symbol", "")).strip().upper()
+        if not symbol:
+            raise ValueError("event must have a symbol")
+        ts = getattr(event, "provider_source_ts", None)
+        if ts is None:
+            ts = getattr(event, "event_time", None)
+        receive = getattr(event, "receive_ts", None)
+        if receive is None:
+            receive = getattr(event, "received_at", None)
+        if ts is None or receive is None:
+            raise ValueError("event must have provider source and receive timestamps")
+        ts, receive = _utc(ts, "provider_source_ts"), _utc(receive, "receive_ts")
+        kind = channel or getattr(event, "kind", "unknown")
+        kind = getattr(kind, "value", kind)
+        kind = str(kind).lower()
+        kind = {"trade": "trades", "quote": "quotes", "bar": "bars"}.get(kind, kind)
+        feed_id = getattr(event, "feed_id", None)
+        provenance = getattr(event, "provenance", None)
+        if feed_id is None and provenance is not None:
+            feed_id = getattr(provenance, "feed", None)
+        if feed_id:
+            self._feed_id = str(feed_id).strip().lower()
+
+        sequence = getattr(event, "sequence_id", None)
+        trade_id = getattr(event, "trade_id", None)
+        price = getattr(event, "price", getattr(event, "close", None))
+        size = getattr(event, "size", getattr(event, "volume", None))
+        if price is None and hasattr(event, "close"):
+            price = event.close
+        if sequence is not None or trade_id is not None:
+            identity = ("id", symbol, kind, sequence if sequence is not None else trade_id)
+        else:
+            identity = ("fallback", symbol, ts, str(price), str(size))
+        if identity in self._seen:
+            key = (symbol, kind)
+            previous = self._freshness.get(key)
+            if previous:
+                self._freshness[key] = ChannelFreshness(
+                    previous.symbol, previous.channel, previous.provider_source_ts,
+                    previous.receive_ts, previous.age_seconds, previous.transport_latency_seconds,
+                    previous.source, previous.stale, previous.out_of_order_count,
+                    previous.duplicate_count + 1,
+                )
+            return False
+        self._seen.add(identity)
+        self._seen_order.append(identity)
+        if len(self._seen_order) > self._seen_window:
+            self._seen.discard(self._seen_order.popleft())
+
+        now = _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")
+        key = (symbol, kind)
+        prior_ts = self._latest_source_ts.get(key)
+        out_of_order = prior_ts is not None and ts < prior_ts
+        if out_of_order:
+            old = self._freshness.get(key)
+            if old:
+                self._freshness[key] = ChannelFreshness(
+                    old.symbol, old.channel, old.provider_source_ts, old.receive_ts,
+                    old.age_seconds, old.transport_latency_seconds, old.source, old.stale,
+                    old.out_of_order_count + 1, old.duplicate_count,
+                )
+            if source == "stream":
+                self._last_stream_activity = receive
+            return True
+        if not out_of_order:
+            self._latest_source_ts[key] = ts
+        old = self._freshness.get(key)
+        threshold = self._thresholds.get(kind)
+        stale = bool(threshold is not None and self._session(now) and (now - ts).total_seconds() > threshold)
+        self._freshness[key] = ChannelFreshness(
+            symbol, kind, ts, receive, (now - ts).total_seconds(),
+            (receive - ts).total_seconds(), source, stale,
+            (old.out_of_order_count if old else 0) + int(out_of_order),
+            old.duplicate_count if old else 0,
+        )
+        if source == "stream":
+            self._last_stream_activity = receive
+        if kind == "bars":
+            self._record_bar(symbol, ts, now)
+        return True
+
+    def _record_bar(self, symbol: str, ts: datetime, now: datetime) -> None:
+        previous = self._last_bar.get(symbol)
+        if previous is not None and ts > previous:
+            cursor = previous + timedelta(minutes=1)
+            while cursor < ts:
+                if cursor + timedelta(minutes=1) <= now:
+                    self._gaps.setdefault(symbol, set()).add(cursor)
+                cursor += timedelta(minutes=1)
+        if previous is None or ts > previous:
+            self._last_bar[symbol] = ts
+
+    def mark_gap_recovered(self, symbol: str, bar_start: datetime) -> None:
+        self._gaps.get(symbol.strip().upper(), set()).discard(_utc(bar_start, "bar_start"))
+
+    def set_stream_connected(self, connected: bool) -> None:
+        self._stream_connected = bool(connected)
+
+    def record_request(self, *, status_code: int | None = None, backoff_seconds: float = 0) -> None:
+        self._requests_used += 1
+        now = _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")
+        if status_code == 429:
+            self._responses_429 += 1
+            if backoff_seconds > 0:
+                until = now + timedelta(seconds=float(backoff_seconds))
+                self._backoff_until = max(self._backoff_until or until, until)
+
+    def rate_limit_snapshot(self) -> RateLimitSnapshot:
+        now = _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")
+        until = self._backoff_until if self._backoff_until and self._backoff_until > now else None
+        return RateLimitSnapshot(
+            self._requests_used, self._responses_429, until,
+            max(0.0, (until - now).total_seconds()) if until else 0.0,
+        )
+
+    def _stream_gap(self, now: datetime) -> bool:
+        return bool(self._last_stream_activity and self._session(now) and
+                    (now - self._last_stream_activity).total_seconds() > self._stream_gap_seconds)
+
+    def symbol_health(self, symbol: str) -> SymbolHealthSnapshot:
+        symbol, now = symbol.strip().upper(), _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")
+        channels: dict[str, ChannelFreshness] = {}
+        reasons: list[str] = []
+        for (sym, channel), item in self._freshness.items():
+            if sym != symbol:
+                continue
+            threshold = self._thresholds.get(channel)
+            stale = bool(threshold is not None and self._session(now) and
+                         (now - item.provider_source_ts).total_seconds() > threshold)
+            channels[channel] = ChannelFreshness(
+                item.symbol, item.channel, item.provider_source_ts, item.receive_ts,
+                (now - item.provider_source_ts).total_seconds(),
+                (item.receive_ts - item.provider_source_ts).total_seconds(), item.source,
+                stale, item.out_of_order_count, item.duplicate_count,
+            )
+            if stale:
+                reasons.append("STALE_DATA")
+        feed_id = self._feed_id
+        mismatch = bool(feed_id and self._configured_feed and feed_id != self._configured_feed)
+        provenance = FeedProvenanceSnapshot(
+            feed_id, False if feed_id == "iex" else (True if feed_id == "sip" else None),
+            self._configured_feed, mismatch,
+        )
+        gaps = tuple(sorted(self._gaps.get(symbol, ())))
+        if gaps:
+            reasons.append("UNRESOLVED_GAP")
+        if mismatch:
+            reasons.append("ENTITLEMENT_MISMATCH")
+        if feed_id not in {"iex", "sip"}:
+            reasons.append("UNKNOWN_FEED_ID")
+        fresh_fallback = any(c.source != "stream" and not c.stale for c in channels.values())
+        gap = self._stream_gap(now) and not (not self._stream_connected and fresh_fallback)
+        if gap:
+            reasons.append("STREAM_ACTIVITY_GAP")
+        if not self._stream_connected and not any(c.source != "stream" and not c.stale for c in channels.values()):
+            reasons.append("STREAM_DISCONNECTED")
+        if not channels:
+            reasons.append("UNKNOWN_FRESHNESS")
+        state = HealthState.OFFLINE if not channels or (not self._stream_connected and "STREAM_DISCONNECTED" in reasons) else (
+            HealthState.DEGRADED if reasons else HealthState.HEALTHY
+        )
+        return SymbolHealthSnapshot(symbol, state, MappingProxyType(channels), provenance,
+                                    gaps, self._stream_connected, gap, tuple(dict.fromkeys(reasons)))
+
+    def service_health(self) -> ServiceHealthSnapshot:
+        now = _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")
+        reasons = []
+        if not self._stream_connected:
+            reasons.append("STREAM_DISCONNECTED")
+        if self.rate_limit_snapshot().backoff_until:
+            reasons.append("RATE_LIMIT_BACKOFF")
+        state = HealthState.OFFLINE if not self._stream_connected else HealthState.DEGRADED if reasons else HealthState.HEALTHY
+        return ServiceHealthSnapshot(state, self._stream_connected, self.rate_limit_snapshot(), tuple(reasons))
+
+    def entries_allowed(self, symbol: str) -> EntryDecision:
+        health = self.symbol_health(symbol)
+        priority = ("UNKNOWN_FRESHNESS", "STALE_DATA", "UNRESOLVED_GAP", "STREAM_DISCONNECTED",
+                    "UNKNOWN_FEED_ID", "ENTITLEMENT_MISMATCH", "STREAM_ACTIVITY_GAP")
+        for code in priority:
+            if code in health.reasons:
+                # A disconnected stream with fresh polling data is permitted.
+                if code == "STREAM_DISCONNECTED" and any(

+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+from mike_trade.market_data.quality import FeedQualityTracker, HealthState
+
+
+class Clock:
+    def __init__(self, value):
+        self.value = value
+
+    def now(self):
+        return self.value
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Event:
+    symbol: str
+    provider_source_ts: datetime
+    receive_ts: datetime
+    feed_id: str = "sip"
+    price: Decimal = Decimal("10")
+    size: Decimal = Decimal("2")
+    sequence_id: int | None = None
+    kind: str = "trade"
+
+
+def tracker(clock, **kwargs):
+    configured_feed_id = kwargs.pop("configured_feed_id", "sip")
+    return FeedQualityTracker(
+        clock=clock,
+        staleness_seconds={"trades": 5, "bars": 90},
+        session_calendar=lambda _now: True,
+        configured_feed_id=configured_feed_id,
+        **kwargs,
+    )
+
+
+def test_age_and_transport_latency_use_distinct_timestamps():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, 0, 10, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now))
+    assert t.ingest(Event("AAPL", now - timedelta(seconds=8), now - timedelta(seconds=3)))
+    fresh = t.symbol_health("AAPL").channels["trades"]
+    assert fresh.age_seconds == 8
+    assert fresh.transport_latency_seconds == 5
+
+
+def test_regular_session_staleness_degrades_and_blocks_entry():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now), stream_activity_gap_seconds=120)
+    t.ingest(Event("AAPL", now - timedelta(seconds=6), now - timedelta(seconds=5)))
+    assert t.symbol_health("AAPL").state is HealthState.DEGRADED
+    decision = t.entries_allowed("AAPL")
+    assert not decision.allowed
+    assert decision.reason_code == "STALE_DATA"
+
+
+def test_unknown_freshness_fails_closed():
+    decision = tracker(Clock(datetime(2026, 1, 5, tzinfo=timezone.utc))).entries_allowed("MSFT")
+    assert not decision.allowed
+    assert decision.reason_code == "UNKNOWN_FRESHNESS"
+
+
+def test_duplicates_by_sequence_and_fallback_are_counted_without_refresh():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now))
+    event = Event("AAPL", now - timedelta(seconds=1), now - timedelta(seconds=1), sequence_id=77)
+    assert t.ingest(event)
+    assert not t.ingest(event)
+    # A later receive time for the same provider sequence remains a duplicate.
+    duplicate = Event("AAPL", event.provider_source_ts, now, sequence_id=77)
+    assert not t.ingest(duplicate)
+    key_event = Event("MSFT", event.provider_source_ts, event.receive_ts, sequence_id=None)
+    assert t.ingest(key_event)
+    assert not t.ingest(key_event)
+    assert t.symbol_health("AAPL").channels["trades"].receive_ts == event.receive_ts
+    assert t.symbol_health("AAPL").channels["trades"].duplicate_count == 2
+    assert t.symbol_health("MSFT").channels["trades"].duplicate_count == 1
+
+
+def test_out_of_order_event_is_counted_without_replacing_latest_source_time():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now), stream_activity_gap_seconds=120)
+    latest = Event("AAPL", now - timedelta(seconds=1), now, sequence_id=2)
+    older = Event("AAPL", now - timedelta(seconds=3), now, sequence_id=1)
+    t.ingest(latest)
+    t.ingest(older)
+    fresh = t.symbol_health("AAPL").channels["trades"]
+    assert fresh.provider_source_ts == latest.provider_source_ts
+    assert fresh.out_of_order_count == 1
+
+
+def test_fresh_polling_fallback_allows_entries_when_stream_disconnects():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now))
+    t.set_stream_connected(False)
+    t.ingest(Event("AAPL", now, now), source="poll")
+    assert t.symbol_health("AAPL").state is HealthState.HEALTHY
+    assert t.entries_allowed("AAPL").allowed
+
+
+def test_missing_completed_minute_bar_blocks_until_recovered():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, 5, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now), stream_activity_gap_seconds=300)
+    first = now - timedelta(minutes=3)
+    t.ingest(Event("AAPL", first, first + timedelta(seconds=1), kind="bar"))
+    t.ingest(Event("AAPL", first + timedelta(minutes=2), first + timedelta(minutes=2, seconds=1), kind="bar"))
+    assert t.symbol_health("AAPL").unresolved_gaps == (first + timedelta(minutes=1),)
+    assert t.entries_allowed("AAPL").reason_code == "UNRESOLVED_GAP"
+    t.mark_gap_recovered("AAPL", first + timedelta(minutes=1))
+    assert t.entries_allowed("AAPL").allowed
+
+
+def test_feed_provenance_mismatch_and_iex_consolidation():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now), configured_feed_id="sip")
+    t.ingest(Event("AAPL", now, now, feed_id="iex"))
+    health = t.symbol_health("AAPL")
+    assert health.feed.feed_id == "iex"
+    assert health.feed.consolidated is False
+    assert health.feed.entitlement_mismatch
+    assert t.entries_allowed("AAPL").reason_code == "ENTITLEMENT_MISMATCH"
+
+
+def test_unrecognized_feed_id_fails_closed():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now))
+    t.ingest(Event("AAPL", now, now, feed_id="mystery"))
+    assert t.entries_allowed("AAPL").reason_code == "UNKNOWN_FEED_ID"
+
+
+def test_rate_limit_counters_and_backoff_are_projected():
+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now))
+    t.record_request(status_code=200)
+    t.record_request(status_code=429, backoff_seconds=12)
+    snapshot = t.service_health()
+    assert snapshot.rate_limit.requests_used == 2
+    assert snapshot.rate_limit.responses_429 == 1
+    assert snapshot.rate_limit.backoff_seconds == 12
+    assert snapshot.state is HealthState.DEGRADED
+
+
+def test_health_controls_entries_only():
+    assert "fills" in FeedQualityTracker.__doc__
+    assert not any(name in FeedQualityTracker.__dict__ for name in (
+        "block_fill", "block_order_update", "block_stop", "block_reconciliation", "block_manual_close"
+    ))

+"""Market-data freshness and provenance health for new-entry decisions only.
+
+This module exposes no controls over broker fills, order updates, stops,
+reconciliation, or manual closes. Its health assessment can only be queried
+through :meth:`FeedQualityTracker.entries_allowed` for prospective entries.
+Snapshots are immutable values suitable for status projections and dashboards.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections import deque
+from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import StrEnum
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import Any
+
+__all__ = [
+    "HealthState", "ChannelFreshness", "FeedProvenanceSnapshot", "RateLimitSnapshot",
+    "SymbolHealthSnapshot", "ServiceHealthSnapshot", "EntryDecision", "FeedQualityTracker",
+]
+
+
+class HealthState(StrEnum):
+    HEALTHY = "HEALTHY"
+    DEGRADED = "DEGRADED"
+    OFFLINE = "OFFLINE"
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(timezone.utc)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ChannelFreshness:
+    symbol: str
+    channel: str
+    provider_source_ts: datetime
+    receive_ts: datetime
+    age_seconds: float
+    transport_latency_seconds: float
+    source: str
+    stale: bool
+    out_of_order_count: int
+    duplicate_count: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class FeedProvenanceSnapshot:
+    feed_id: str | None
+    consolidated: bool | None
+    configured_feed_id: str | None
+    entitlement_mismatch: bool
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class RateLimitSnapshot:
+    requests_used: int
+    responses_429: int
+    backoff_until: datetime | None
+    backoff_seconds: float
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SymbolHealthSnapshot:
+    symbol: str
+    state: HealthState
+    channels: Mapping[str, ChannelFreshness]
+    feed: FeedProvenanceSnapshot
+    unresolved_gaps: tuple[datetime, ...]
+    stream_connected: bool
+    stream_gap: bool
+    reasons: tuple[str, ...]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ServiceHealthSnapshot:
+    state: HealthState
+    stream_connected: bool
+    rate_limit: RateLimitSnapshot
+    reasons: tuple[str, ...]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class EntryDecision:
+    allowed: bool
+    reason_code: str | None
+
+
+class FeedQualityTracker:
+    """Track data health; only ``entries_allowed`` expresses entry eligibility.
+
+    The tracker cannot block broker fills, order updates, stops, reconciliation,
+    or manual closes.
+
+    ``session_calendar`` returns whether regular-session freshness rules apply
+    at the supplied UTC time. Staleness thresholds are seconds by channel.
+    Events may be normalized stream records, poll snapshots, or MarketEvent-like
+    values carrying equivalent timestamp/provenance fields.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        clock: Any,
+        staleness_seconds: Mapping[str, float],
+        session_calendar: Callable[[datetime], bool],
+        configured_feed_id: str | None = None,
+        seen_window: int = 4096,
+        stream_activity_gap_seconds: float = 30.0,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not callable(getattr(clock, "now", None)):
+            raise TypeError("clock must expose now()")
+        if not callable(session_calendar):
+            raise TypeError("session_calendar must be callable")
+        if seen_window < 1 or stream_activity_gap_seconds < 0:
+            raise ValueError("seen_window must be positive and stream gap non-negative")
+        if any(float(v) < 0 for v in staleness_seconds.values()):
+            raise ValueError("staleness thresholds must be non-negative")
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._thresholds = {str(k).lower(): float(v) for k, v in staleness_seconds.items()}
+        self._session = session_calendar
+        self._configured_feed = configured_feed_id.lower() if configured_feed_id else None
+        self._seen_window = seen_window
+        self._stream_gap_seconds = float(stream_activity_gap_seconds)
+        self._freshness: dict[tuple[str, str], ChannelFreshness] = {}
+        self._latest_source_ts: dict[tuple[str, str], datetime] = {}
+        self._seen: set[tuple[Any, ...]] = set()
+        self._seen_order: deque[tuple[Any, ...]] = deque()
+        self._feed_id: str | None = None
+        self._stream_connected = True
+        self._last_stream_activity: datetime | None = None
+        self._gaps: dict[str, set[datetime]] = {}
+        self._last_bar: dict[str, datetime] = {}
+        self._requests_used = 0
+        self._responses_429 = 0
+        self._backoff_until: datetime | None = None
+
+    def ingest(self, event: Any, *, channel: str | None = None, source: str = "stream") -> bool:
+        """Record an event; returns False for a duplicate (not fresh activity)."""
+        symbol = str(getattr(event, "symbol", "")).strip().upper()
+        if not symbol:
+            raise ValueError("event must have a symbol")
+        ts = getattr(event, "provider_source_ts", None)
+        if ts is None:
+            ts = getattr(event, "event_time", None)
+        receive = getattr(event, "receive_ts", None)
+        if receive is None:
+            receive = getattr(event, "received_at", None)
+        if ts is None or receive is None:
+            raise ValueError("event must have provider source and receive timestamps")
+        ts, receive = _utc(ts, "provider_source_ts"), _utc(receive, "receive_ts")
+        kind = channel or getattr(event, "kind", "unknown")
+        kind = getattr(kind, "value", kind)
+        kind = str(kind).lower()
+        kind = {"trade": "trades", "quote": "quotes", "bar": "bars"}.get(kind, kind)
+        feed_id = getattr(event, "feed_id", None)
+        provenance = getattr(event, "provenance", None)
+        if feed_id is None and provenance is not None:
+            feed_id = getattr(provenance, "feed", None)
+        if feed_id:
+            self._feed_id = str(feed_id).strip().lower()
+
+        sequence = getattr(event, "sequence_id", None)
+        trade_id = getattr(event, "trade_id", None)
+        price = getattr(event, "price", getattr(event, "close", None))
+        size = getattr(event, "size", getattr(event, "volume", None))
+        if price is None and hasattr(event, "close"):
+            price = event.close
+        if sequence is not None or trade_id is not None:
+            identity = ("id", symbol, kind, sequence if sequence is not None else trade_id)
+        else:
+            identity = ("fallback", symbol, ts, str(price), str(size))
+        if identity in self._seen:
+            key = (symbol, kind)
+            previous = self._freshness.get(key)
+            if previous:
+                self._freshness[key] = ChannelFreshness(
+                    previous.symbol, previous.channel, previous.provider_source_ts,
+                    previous.receive_ts, previous.age_seconds, previous.transport_latency_seconds,
+                    previous.source, previous.stale, previous.out_of_order_count,
+                    previous.duplicate_count + 1,
+                )
+            return False
+        self._seen.add(identity)
+        self._seen_order.append(identity)
+        if len(self._seen_order) > self._seen_window:
+            self._seen.discard(self._seen_order.popleft())
+
+        now = _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")
+        key = (symbol, kind)
+        prior_ts = self._latest_source_ts.get(key)
+        out_of_order = prior_ts is not None and ts < prior_ts
+        if out_of_order:
+            old = self._freshness.get(key)
+            if old:
+                self._freshness[key] = ChannelFreshness(
+                    old.symbol, old.channel, old.provider_source_ts, old.receive_ts,
+                    old.age_seconds, old.transport_latency_seconds, old.source, old.stale,
+                    old.out_of_order_count + 1, old.duplicate_count,
+                )
+            if source == "stream":
+                self._last_stream_activity = receive
+            return True
+        if not out_of_order:
+            self._latest_source_ts[key] = ts
+        old = self._freshness.get(key)
+        threshold = self._thresholds.get(kind)
+        stale = bool(threshold is not None and self._session(now) and (now - ts).total_seconds() > threshold)
+        self._freshness[key] = ChannelFreshness(
+            symbol, kind, ts, receive, (now - ts).total_seconds(),
+            (receive - ts).total_seconds(), source, stale,
+            (old.out_of_order_count if old else 0) + int(out_of_order),
+            old.duplicate_count if old else 0,
+        )
+        if source == "stream":
+            self._last_stream_activity = receive
+        if kind == "bars":
+            self._record_bar(symbol, ts, now)
+        return True
+
+    def _record_bar(self, symbol: str, ts: datetime, now: datetime) -> None:
+        previous = self._last_bar.get(symbol)
+        if previous is not None and ts > previous:
+            cursor = previous + timedelta(minutes=1)
+            while cursor < ts:
+                if cursor + timedelta(minutes=1) <= now:
+                    self._gaps.setdefault(symbol, set()).add(cursor)
+                cursor += timedelta(minutes=1)
+        if previous is None or ts > previous:
+            self._last_bar[symbol] = ts
+
+    def mark_gap_recovered(self, symbol: str, bar_start: datetime) -> None:
+        self._gaps.get(symbol.strip().upper(), set()).discard(_utc(bar_start, "bar_start"))
+
+    def set_stream_connected(self, connected: bool) -> None:
+        self._stream_connected = bool(connected)
+
+    def record_request(self, *, status_code: int | None = None, backoff_seconds: float = 0) -> None:
+        self._requests_used += 1
+        now = _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")
+        if status_code == 429:
+            self._responses_429 += 1
+            if backoff_seconds > 0:
+                until = now + timedelta(seconds=float(backoff_seconds))
+                self._backoff_until = max(self._backoff_until or until, until)
+
+    def rate_limit_snapshot(self) -> RateLimitSnapshot:
+        now = _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")
+        until = self._backoff_until if self._backoff_until and self._backoff_until > now else None
+        return RateLimitSnapshot(
+            self._requests_used, self._responses_429, until,
+            max(0.0, (until - now).total_seconds()) if until else 0.0,
+        )
+
+    def _stream_gap(self, now: datetime) -> bool:
+        return bool(self._last_stream_activity and self._session(now) and
+                    (now - self._last_stream_activity).total_seconds() > self._stream_gap_seconds)
+
+    def symbol_health(self, symbol: str) -> SymbolHealthSnapshot:
+        symbol, now = symbol.strip().upper(), _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")
+        channels: dict[str, ChannelFreshness] = {}
+        reasons: list[str] = []
+        for (sym, channel), item in self._freshness.items():
+            if sym != symbol:
+                continue
+            threshold = self._thresholds.get(channel)
+            stale = bool(threshold is not None and self._session(now) and
+                         (now - item.provider_source_ts).total_seconds() > threshold)
+            channels[channel] = ChannelFreshness(
+                item.symbol, item.channel, item.provider_source_ts, item.receive_ts,
+                (now - item.provider_source_ts).total_seconds(),
+                (item.receive_ts - item.provider_source_ts).total_seconds(), item.source,
+                stale, item.out_of_order_count, item.duplicate_count,
+            )
+            if stale:
+                reasons.append("STALE_DATA")
+        feed_id = self._feed_id
+        mismatch = bool(feed_id and self._configured_feed and feed_id != self._configured_feed)
+        provenance = FeedProvenanceSnapshot(
+            feed_id, False if feed_id == "iex" else (True if feed_id == "sip" else None),
+            self._configured_feed, mismatch,
+        )
+        gaps = tuple(sorted(self._gaps.get(symbol, ())))
+        if gaps:
+            reasons.append("UNRESOLVED_GAP")
+        if mismatch:
+            reasons.append("ENTITLEMENT_MISMATCH")
+        if feed_id not in {"iex", "sip"}:
+            reasons.append("UNKNOWN_FEED_ID")
+        fresh_fallback = any(c.source != "stream" and not c.stale for c in channels.values())
+        gap = self._stream_gap(now) and not (not self._stream_connected and fresh_fallback)
+        if gap:
+            reasons.append("STREAM_ACTIVITY_GAP")
+        if not self._stream_connected and not any(c.source != "stream" and not c.stale for c in channels.values()):
+            reasons.append("STREAM_DISCONNECTED")
+        if not channels:
+            reasons.append("UNKNOWN_FRESHNESS")
+        state = HealthState.OFFLINE if not channels or (not self._stream_connected and "STREAM_DISCONNECTED" in reasons) else (
+            HealthState.DEGRADED if reasons else HealthState.HEALTHY
+        )
+        return SymbolHealthSnapshot(symbol, state, MappingProxyType(channels), provenance,
+                                    gaps, self._stream_connected, gap, tuple(dict.fromkeys(reasons)))
+
+    def service_health(self) -> ServiceHealthSnapshot:
+        now = _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")
+        reasons = []
+        if not self._stream_connected:
+            reasons.append("STREAM_DISCONNECTED")
+        if self.rate_limit_snapshot().backoff_until:
+            reasons.append("RATE_LIMIT_BACKOFF")
+        state = HealthState.OFFLINE if not self._stream_connected else HealthState.DEGRADED if reasons else HealthState.HEALTHY
+        return ServiceHealthSnapshot(state, self._stream_connected, self.rate_limit_snapshot(), tuple(reasons))
+
+    def entries_allowed(self, symbol: str) -> EntryDecision:
+        health = self.symbol_health(symbol)
+        priority = ("UNKNOWN_FRESHNESS", "STALE_DATA", "UNRESOLVED_GAP", "STREAM_DISCONNECTED",
+                    "UNKNOWN_FEED_ID", "ENTITLEMENT_MISMATCH", "STREAM_ACTIVITY_GAP")
+        for code in priority:
+            if code in health.reasons:
+                # A disconnected stream with fresh polling data is permitted.
+                if code == "STREAM_DISCONNECTED" and any(
+                    c.source != "stream" and not c.stale for c in health.channels.values()
+                ):
+                    continue
+                return EntryDecision(False, code)
+        return EntryDecision(True, None)

class RestMarketDataPoller:
    """Fetch each watched symbol once per market-data kind in one batched call."""

    _ENDPOINTS = {
        PollKind.TRADE: "/v2/stocks/trades/latest",
        PollKind.QUOTE: "/v2/stocks/quotes/latest",
        PollKind.BAR: "/v2/stocks/bars/latest",
    }

    def __init__(
        self,
        client: Any,
        *,
        clock: Any,
        feed: str = "iex",
        requests_per_second: float = 5.0,
        burst: int = 5,
        poll_interval_seconds: float = 1.0,
        max_poll_interval_seconds: float = 60.0,
        max_symbols_per_cycle: int = 100,
        stale_after_seconds: float = 30.0,
        max_gap: timedelta = timedelta(hours=1),
        sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
        kinds: Sequence[str] = (PollKind.TRADE, PollKind.QUOTE, PollKind.BAR),
    ) -> None:
        if not callable(getattr(client, "get", None)):
            raise TypeError("client must expose get(path, params)")
        if not callable(getattr(clock, "now", None)):
            raise TypeError("clock must expose now()")
        if poll_interval_seconds <= 0 or max_poll_interval_seconds <= 0:
            raise ValueError("poll intervals must be positive")
        if max_symbols_per_cycle < 1 or stale_after_seconds < 0 or max_gap <= timedelta(0):
            raise ValueError("poll bounds must be positive")
        if any(kind not in self._ENDPOINTS for kind in kinds) or not kinds:
            raise ValueError("kinds must contain trade, quote, and/or bar")
        self._client, self._clock, self.feed = client, clock, feed.strip().lower()
        self.poll_interval_seconds = min(poll_interval_seconds, max_poll_interval_seconds)
        self.max_poll_interval_seconds = max_poll_interval_seconds
        self.max_symbols_per_cycle = max_symbols_per_cycle
        self.stale_after_seconds = stale_after_seconds
        self.max_gap = max_gap
        self.kinds = tuple(dict.fromkeys(kinds))
        self._bucket = TokenBucket(
            capacity=burst, refill_per_second=requests_per_second, clock=clock.now, sleep=sleep
        )
        self._last_ts: dict[tuple[str, str], datetime] = {}
        self._retry_until: datetime | None = None
        self._sleep = sleep

    def _get(self, path: str, params: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> Any:
        retries = 0
        while True:
            self._bucket.acquire()
            try:
                response = self._client.get(path, params=dict(params) if params else None)
            except Exception as exc:
                status = getattr(exc, "status_code", None) or getattr(
                    getattr(exc, "response", None), "status_code", None
                )
                if status != 429:
                    raise
                headers = getattr(exc, "headers", None) or getattr(
                    getattr(exc, "response", None), "headers", {}
                )
                delay = self._retry_after(headers)
                self._bucket.defer(delay)
                retries += 1
                if retries > 3:
                    raise PollingError("Alpaca remained rate limited after retries") from exc
                continue
            status = getattr(response, "status_code", None)
            if status == 429:
                delay = self._retry_after(getattr(response, "headers", {}))
                self._bucket.defer(delay)
                retries += 1
                if retries > 3:
                    raise PollingError("Alpaca remained rate limited after retries")
                continue
            if status is not None and status >= 400:
                raise PollingError(f"Alpaca request failed with HTTP {status}")
            return response.json() if callable(getattr(response, "json", None)) else response

    def _retry_after(self, headers: Mapping[str, Any]) -> float:
        value = next((v for k, v in headers.items() if str(k).lower() == "retry-after"), None)

def _provenance(feed_id: str) -> FeedProvenance:
    return FeedProvenance(
        provider="alpaca",
            Timeframe.M5: timedelta(minutes=5),
            Timeframe.M15: timedelta(minutes=15),
            Timeframe.H1: timedelta(hours=1),
            Timeframe.D1: timedelta(days=1),
        }[self]


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class FeedProvenance:
    """Where a market data point came from.

    Alpaca Basic IEX is represented with ``is_consolidated=False`` so IEX
    provenance is never mistaken for consolidated SIP data.
    """

    provider: str
    feed: str
    source: str
    is_consolidated: bool

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for field in ("provider", "feed", "source"):
            value = getattr(self, field)
            if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
                raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty str")
            object.__setattr__(self, field, value.strip())
        if not isinstance(self.is_consolidated, bool):
            raise ValueError("is_consolidated must be bool")

+                    previous.receive_ts, previous.age_seconds, previous.transport_latency_seconds,

+                    previous.duplicate_count + 1,

+        self._requests_used += 1
+        now = _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock")

+
+    def now(self):
+        return self.value

+    symbol: str
+    provider_source_ts: datetime
+    receive_ts: datetime
+    feed_id: str = "sip"

+    size: Decimal = Decimal("2")
+    sequence_id: int | None = None
+    kind: str = "trade"
+

+    return FeedQualityTracker(
+        clock=clock,
+        staleness_seconds={"trades": 5, "bars": 90},
+        session_calendar=lambda _now: True,
+        configured_feed_id="sip",
+        **kwargs,

+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, 0, 10, tzinfo=UTC)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now))

+    fresh = t.symbol_health("AAPL").channels["trades"]
+    assert fresh.age_seconds == 8
+    assert fresh.transport_latency_seconds == 5
+

+    now = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 15, 0, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
+    t = tracker(Clock(now))
+    t.ingest(Event("AAPL", now - timedelta(seconds=6), now - timedelta(seconds=5)))

+    decision = t.entries_allowed("AAPL")
+    assert not decision.allowed
